1.w: Written by the Korahites; a psalm, a song. The Lord ’s city is in the holy hills.

2.w: The Lord loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwelling places of Jacob.

3.w: People say wonderful things about you, O city of God. (Selah)

4.w: I mention Rahab and Babylon to my followers. Here are Philistia and Tyre, along with Ethiopia. It is said of them, “This one was born there.”

5.w: But it is said of Zion’s residents, “Each one of these was born in her, and the Most High makes her secure.”

6.w: The Lord writes in the census book of the nations, “This one was born there.” (Selah)

7.w: As for the singers, as well as the pipers— all of them sing within your walls.
